newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end weaker, extend recent slide.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end weaker, extend recent slide.

text.p: * Toronto stocks continued to slide for a second straight day, ending weaker on Tuesday due to sagging gold shares * Brisk turnover of 121 million shares worth C$2 billion.
Toronto stocks closed weaker on Tuesday, dragged into negative territory by weaker gold stocks and profit-taking.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index fell 37.92 points to 6075.98 for a second straight day of losses. Trading was brisk at 120.9 million shares worth C$2.1 billion.
Gold stocks began the day stronger, but turned weaker along volatile bullion prices. "We had a negative reversal in gold," said MMS International analyst Katherine Beattie.
Midland Walwyn analyst Dunnery Best said investors reaped the benefits of Toronto's recent rally by selling stocks.
